items.title: OPEC+ Set to Keep Oil Quotas Unchanged
items.desc: The key OPEC+ producers managing their collective oil production are expected to keep quotas unchanged for December when they meet on Sunday, sources familiar with the plans told Reuters on Tuesday. Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria, and Oman have kept their targeted output unchanged after completing in September the phased rollback of 1.65 million barrels per day (bpd) of supply cuts first agreed in 2023. items.desc: Publicly traded companies represent a tiny share of the total number of companies producing crude oil and natural gas in the United States, but they make up a large share of U.S. production. items.title: EIA expects a drop in global oil demand will limit price increases from Hormuz disruptions
items.desc: The U.S. Energy Information Administration published its June Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO), reducing its expectation for global oil demand in 2026. High fuel prices, reduced fuel availability, and government initiatives are curbing oil consumption this year, particularly in Asia, resulting in the world consuming 1 million fewer barrels of oil each day on average than it did last year. The reduced demand could limit crude oil price increases resulting from near-term disruptions in the flow of oil out of the Middle East through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Elevated crack spreads and crude oil prices contribute to higher prices at the pump
items.desc: What are crack spreads and why are they elevated? Crack spreads are indicators of the profitability of refining crude oil into petroleum products such as gasoline and diesel. One common crack spread is calculated by subtracting the spot market price of a gallon of crude oil from the wholesale price of a gallon of refined product. Since May, the gasoline crack spread in New York Harbor has averaged about $1 per gallon (gal) higher than in 2025, when the crack spread peaked around 60 cents/gal. Gasoline crack spreads are elevated primarily because of tight gasoline supplies globally.

items.title: What goes into diesel prices?
items.desc: The price of distillate fuel oil, often sold as diesel, is driven by the price of crude oil, retail margins, distribution costs, taxes, and crack spreads, the indicator we use for refining margins. Tight global supplies of distillate fuel oil and elevated crude oil prices have driven prices higher in recent months.
items.title_zh: 柴油价格由哪些因素决定？
items.desc_zh: 柴油价格受原油价格、零售利润、分销成本、税收和裂解价差驱动；全球馏分油供应紧张及油价高企推升价格。
items.event: 柴油价格受原油及裂解价差驱动
items.impact: 油价高企支撑柴油成本，馏分油紧张延续

items.title: New England natural gas prices have been trading near record discounts to Henry Hub
items.desc: Low-cost Appalachian and Canadian natural gas supplies coupled with lower-than-usual regional consumption have pushed down natural gas prices at a major New England pricing hub in recent months to trade at a discount to the widely cited U.S. benchmark, Henry Hub.
items.title_zh: 新英格兰天然气价格对Henry Hub折价接近纪录
items.desc_zh: Appalachia和加拿大低成本供应叠加区域消费偏低，推动新英格兰主要枢纽气价对Henry Hub大幅折价。
items.event: 新英格兰气价对Henry Hub深度折价
items.impact: 区域气价分化，折价反映供应宽松格局

items.title: U.S. LNG exports rose 23% in the first half of 2026 because of higher capacity
items.desc: U.S. liquefied natural gas (LNG) exports averaged 17.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in the first six months of the year, 23% more than the same period in 2025, according to our Natural Gas Monthly. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we estimate U.S. LNG exports will average 17.3 Bcf/d in the second half of 2026 (2H26) before rising to 18.7 Bcf/d in 1H27.
items.title_zh: 美国上半年LNG出口增长23%
items.desc_zh: 美国LNG出口均值达174亿立方英尺/日，同比增长23%，因产能提升；EIA预计短期均值173亿立方英尺/日。
items.event: 美国上半年LNG出口同比增23%
items.impact: LNG产能扩张增加全球气源供应

items.title: U.S. refineries have been running at very high rates in 2026
items.desc: The U.S. refinery fleet has run at higher-than-normal rates this year, with refinery utilization averaging more than 95% of capacity between May and September, the highest for those months since 1998. Tight global product supplies this year have boosted margins for petroleum products, particularly for diesel, incentivizing the increased run rates.
items.title_zh: 美国炼油厂2026年开工率维持高位
items.desc_zh: 美国炼厂今年开工率高于正常水平，5月至9月产能利用率平均超95%，为1998年以来同期最高。全球成品油供应紧张推升炼油利润，尤其利好馏分油。
items.event: 美国炼厂开工率创1998年来同期最高
items.impact: 成品油供应偏紧，支撑原油及馏分油价格

items.title: Corpus Christi LNG expansion makes facility the second-largest in the United States
items.desc: On August 28, 2026, Cheniere Energy, Inc., completed its Corpus Christi Liquefaction Stage 3 Project (CCL Stage 3) in Texas, taking custody and control of the seventh and last liquefied natural gas (LNG) train in the project.
items.title_zh: Corpus Christi LNG扩建成为美国第二大LNG设施
items.desc_zh: 2026年8月28日，Cheniere Energy完成德州Corpus Christi液化三期项目，接管该项目第七列也是最后一列LNG生产线。
items.event: Cheniere完成Corpus Christi三期扩产
items.data_note: 8月28日接管第七列生产线，成美第二大LNG设施
items.impact: LNG供应增加，国际天然气3.494 +0.92%

items.title: Codelco copper mine blockade adds to supply concerns
items.desc: Workers forced a production halt at Ministro Hales in Chile for six hours over unpaid bonuses.
items.title_zh: Codelco铜矿遭封锁加剧供应担忧
items.desc_zh: 智利Ministro Hales矿工人因奖金未付强制停产六小时，加剧铜供应担忧。
items.event: Codelco铜矿工人封锁停产六小时
items.impact: 铜矿供应扰动，但LME铜微跌显背离

items.title: Canada Nickel, Swiss Steel plan transatlantic partnership
items.desc: Canada Nickel would provide Swiss Steel with access to about one million tonnes of semi-finished steel products per year starting in 2030.
items.title_zh: Canada Nickel与Swiss Steel拟建跨大西洋合作
items.desc_zh: Canada Nickel将从2030年起每年向Swiss Steel供应约100万吨半成品钢材。
items.event: Canada Nickel与Swiss Steel签长期供应协议
items.data_note: 2030年起年供约100万吨半成品钢材
items.impact: 长协锁定镍钢需求，暂无镍品种数据

items.title: Codelco, BHP launch $40M copper hunt in northern Chile
items.desc: The companies have partnered to further explore the Anillo copper project as the rush for the critical mineral accelerates.
items.title_zh: Codelco与BHP在智利北部启动4000万美元铜矿勘探
items.desc_zh: 两家公司合作进一步勘探Anillo铜矿项目，关键矿产争夺加速。
items.event: Codelco与BHP合作勘探Anillo铜矿
items.impact: 远期铜矿增量预期，短期铜价反应平淡

items.title: Lula’s Brazil win puts rare earths in Trump’s crosshairs
items.desc: Foreign miners face tighter scrutiny as Brasília pursues domestic processing and resists Washington's trade pressure.
items.title_zh: 卢拉胜选令巴西稀土成特朗普目标
items.desc_zh: 外国矿商面临更严格审查，巴西推进国内加工并抵制美国贸易压力。
items.event: 巴西稀土政策引美国审查
items.data_note: 暂无稀土期货数据；北方稀土A股35.15 -0.57%
items.impact: 稀土供应格局或受扰动，影响稀土品种

items.title: Buried sediments prove Romans mined gold in Pyrenees
items.desc: Researchers have dated a vast hydraulic mining complex in Catalonia, revealing how ancient Romans extracted precious metals.
items.title_zh: 埋藏沉积物证实罗马人在比利牛斯山开采黄金
items.desc_zh: 研究人员对加泰罗尼亚一处大型水力采矿遗址进行了年代测定，揭示了古罗马人如何开采贵金属。
items.event: 考古证实罗马时期金矿开采
items.impact: 历史事件无短期供需影响，金价方向不明

items.title: Mixed outlook for energy expenditures this winter
items.desc: We expect energy expenditures this winter to vary because of diverging trends in energy prices among fuels and regional variation in forecast temperatures. We expect that lower prices for natural gas and propane will drive decreases in expenditures this year for the half of U.S. households heating with those fuels. Higher prices for electricity and heating oil drive increased expenditures for households heating with those fuels in our forecast.
items.title_zh: 今年冬季能源支出前景喜忧参半
items.desc_zh: 预计今年冬季能源支出因各燃料价格走势分化及地区气温预测差异而有所不同。天然气和丙烷价格下降将推动半数美国家庭取暖支出减少。
items.event: 美冬季取暖支出因气价下降分化
items.impact: 气价下行利空天然气，取暖成本降

items.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
items.desc: Petroleum markets in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26) were characterized by increasing prices for crude oil and petroleum products amid persistent conflict in the Middle East.
items.title_zh: 原油价格和炼油利润率在第三季度普遍上涨
items.desc_zh: 2026年第三季度石油市场特征为原油和石油产品价格在中东持续冲突背景下上涨。
items.event: 三季度原油及炼油利润普遍上涨
items.impact: 中东冲突支撑油价，利好原油及炼化

items.title: U.S. natural gas production reached a record high in July 2026
items.desc: U.S. natural gas production hit an all-time high in July 2026, driven primarily by increased output in the Permian Basin, according to our latest Natural Gas Monthly.
items.title_zh: 美国天然气产量在2026年7月创历史新高
items.desc_zh: 据最新《天然气月报》，2026年7月美国天然气产量创历史新高，主要受Permian Basin产量增长推动。
items.event: 美7月天然气产量创历史新高
items.impact: 产量新高利空气价，压制天然气品种
